job.name: Four value-index routes in C11/GMP and C++20/Boost

limitations: The fixture covers closed Bool, String and Nat value indices: both booleans, empty and Unicode strings, zero and a Nat wider than 64 bits.
Ordinary Lean source and independently reviewed Binding IR are exercised through full and result-only C and C++ packages.
Independent C11/GMP and C++20/Boost callers execute installed packages after author removal, offline installation, physical relocation and consumer-source removal.
Complete native archives, receipts, reports, controls, TAP, execution records, toolchain log, GitHub API records and a byte-exact split of the original artifact ZIP are retained.
The package floor is glibc 2.38; external compiler, Lean, GMP, Boost and operating-system distributions remain trusted inputs represented by recorded identities rather than copied toolchains.
This lane establishes installed C and C++ acceptance only; aggregate support promotion and other value-index hosts require separate evidence.
